name: Joan Growe
summary: Joan Ruth Anderson Growe (born September 28, 1935) is an American politician who served as Secretary of State of Minnesota from 1975 to 1999. Known for her work to encourage voter participation, Growe had the second-longest tenure of any secretary of state in Minnesota history, at 24 years. In 1984, she ran for the US Senate against the Republican incumbent, Rudy Boschwitz, losing the election with 41% of the vote.
